title: Priority Quantile Turn Grouper + GPU Slab Consolidation for Streaming Completions
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Introduce a turn-aware grouping heuristic that forms micro-bundles based on request priority quantiles, conversational turn boundaries, and GPU slab consolidation signals. Goal is to reduce GPU fragmentation and per-token cost for streaming chat completions without degrading p95 latency for interactive flows.
acceptance_criteria: P95 tail latency for streaming chat remains <= 90ms on the 95th percentile traffic profile compared to baseline
End-to-end tokens-per-second cost reduced by >= 10% for mixed-priority workloads (measured in staging), with no regression in top-5 customer prompts
KV cache hit rate for frequently resumed sessions improves or stays constant (no >1% regression), validated across 48h workload replay
No increase in out-of-memory crashes on our smallest slab instance during 24h soak test
Can be toggled with config flags (quantile_threshold, slab_compact_threshold, max_microbundle_size) per deployment mode
implementation_plan: Design: define quantile-based priority buckets (q0..q4) and turn-separation heuristics so that long-turn interactive flows are isolated from high-throughput background streams
Runtime: add a microbundle builder that groups inflight streaming tokens by (priority_quantile, session_intent_tag, contiguous-turn-window) up to max_microbundle_size or time-window
KV cache: implement delta-snapshot admission where only new KV entries within a microbundle are promoted to GPU cache; maintain lightweight per-session LRU hints
GPU memory: add slab consolidation pass that coalesces small allocations from adjacent microbundles and triggers async compaction when free-rate < slab_compact_threshold
Fallbacks: if slab compaction is unavailable or OOM risk detected, flow falls back to conservative grouping with strict per-session isolation
Testing: unit tests + integration tests with workload replay; synthetic mixtures (interactive-heavy, background-heavy, mixed)
design_decisions: Use quantile buckets instead of fixed priority tiers to adapt to skewed traffic distributions
Preserve turn boundaries: never split a single user turn across micro-bundles to avoid coherency issues for streaming token interleaving
Delta KV snapshots reduce write amplification to GPU cache and lower eviction churn for hot sessions
Aggressive slab consolidation is asynchronous to avoid adding tail latency in the hot path
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Microbundle misclassification could increase latency for high-priority short requests -> Mitigation: emergency preemption token that promotes small high-priority packets into a fast-path bundle
Risk: Slab compaction CPU overhead -> Mitigation: throttle compaction and run on designated maintenance cores during low load
Risk: KV snapshot mismatch on failover -> Mitigation: include a lightweight validation checksum and deterministic fallback to full KV sync on mismatch
blocking_issues: Need deterministic benchmark harness for mixed-priority streaming to validate cost savings (ENG-45188 as dependency)
Autoscaler integration for slab-aware instance sizing incomplete (depends on ENG-45302)
